outputs.notes: Added portfolioEvidenceAttachments table (bytea, cascade FK to portfolio_evidence, index on evidence_item_id). Migration 0019 applied to dev DB. Repository: insertEvidenceAttachment (MAX_EVIDENCE_ATTACHMENT_BYTES=2097152, MIME allowlist: image/png|jpeg|webp|gif + application/pdf), getEvidenceAttachment (returns row with bytes), listEvidenceAttachments (metadata only, no bytes), deleteEvidenceAttachment. EvidenceAttachmentMeta type added to features/portfolio/types.ts; EvidenceItem.attachments?: EvidenceAttachmentMeta[] added.

POST /evidence/:id/attachments, GET /evidence/attachments/:attachmentId, DELETE /evidence/attachments/:attachmentId implemented in evidence-attachments.ts. Ownership checked via getEvidenceRow(id, householdId). Upload returns EvidenceAttachmentMeta (no bytes). Wired into router.ts at slug positions [evidence, :id, attachments] and [evidence, attachments, :attachmentId].

EvidenceForm: file input (image/png|jpeg|webp|gif + PDF), client-side size/MIME check (errors.attachment), createObjectURL preview (revoked on unmount/replace via useRef), two-step submit (onSave -> uploadEvidenceAttachment on success). onSave prop changed to return Promise<EvidenceItem>. portfolioApi gained uploadEvidenceAttachment and deleteEvidenceAttachment. PortfolioPage.handleCreate and PortfolioTab.handleSave updated to return EvidenceItem.

EvidenceListItem: renders item.attachments as image thumbnails (img tag + link to GET route) or PDF filename/icon links; each visually distinct from url link. Remove button per attachment when onDeleteAttachment prop provided; uses InlineConfirm pattern with confirmingId state. AttachmentRow extracted as local component.
